---
title: "ddQC"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
# Loading the required packages 
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(patchwork)

# Adding the input files and output directory
infile  <- "/projectnb/ds596/projects/'Team 9'/scQC_project/colon_immune_raw.rds"
out_dir <- "ddqc_analysis"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Setting the defaults for ddqc 
basic_n_counts <- 0
basic_n_genes <- 100
basic_percent_mito <- 80

ddqc_threshold <- 2.0   
npcs_use <- 50
k_param <- 20
cluster_resolution <- 1.3
random_seed <- 29

n_genes_lower_bound <- 200
percent_mito_upper_bound <- 10

# Reading the Seurat object
seurat_obj <- readRDS(infile)

cat("Loaded object with", nrow(seurat_obj), "genes and", ncol(seurat_obj), "cells\n")

# Computing the missing QC metrics
if (!"percent.mt" %in% colnames(seurat_obj@meta.data)) {
  seurat_obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_obj, pattern = "^MT-")
}

if (!"percent.ribo" %in% colnames(seurat_obj@meta.data)) {
  ribo_genes <- grep("^RP[SL]", rownames(seurat_obj), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  if (length(ribo_genes) > 0) {
    seurat_obj[["percent.ribo"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_obj, features = ribo_genes)
  } else {
    seurat_obj[["percent.ribo"]] <- 0
    warning("No ribosomal genes matched; percent.ribo set to 0.")
  }
}

# Performing the basic filtering step
seu_prefilt <- subset(
  seurat_obj,
  subset = nCount_RNA >= basic_n_counts &
           nFeature_RNA >= basic_n_genes &
           percent.mt <= basic_percent_mito
)

cat("Cells after basic filtering:", ncol(seu_prefilt), "\n")

# Performing the pre-ddqc clustering
set.seed(random_seed)

seu_cluster <- seu_prefilt

seu_cluster <- NormalizeData(seu_cluster, verbose = FALSE)
seu_cluster <- FindVariableFeatures(seu_cluster, verbose = FALSE)
seu_cluster <- ScaleData(seu_cluster, verbose = FALSE)
seu_cluster <- RunPCA(seu_cluster, npcs = npcs_use, verbose = FALSE)
seu_cluster <- FindNeighbors(
  seu_cluster,
  dims = 1:npcs_use,
  k.param = k_param,
  verbose = FALSE
)

# Louvain clustering
seu_cluster <- FindClusters(
  seu_cluster,
  resolution = cluster_resolution,
  algorithm = 1,
  random.seed = random_seed,
  verbose = FALSE
)

seu_cluster <- RunUMAP(seu_cluster, dims = 1:npcs_use, verbose = FALSE)

cat("Clusters found:", length(unique(seu_cluster$seurat_clusters)), "\n")

# Building the metadata table
meta_ddqc <- seu_cluster@meta.data %>%
  rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = as.character(seurat_clusters),
    n_counts = nCount_RNA,
    n_genes = nFeature_RNA,
    percent_mito = percent.mt,
    percent_ribo = percent.ribo
  )

# Adding the cluster-specific MAD thresholds
ddqc_cutoffs <- meta_ddqc %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cells = n(),

    counts_median = median(n_counts, na.rm = TRUE),
    counts_mad = mad(n_counts, center = median(n_counts, na.rm = TRUE), constant = 1.4826, na.rm = TRUE),

    genes_median = median(n_genes, na.rm = TRUE),
    genes_mad = mad(n_genes, center = median(n_genes, na.rm = TRUE), constant = 1.4826, na.rm = TRUE),

    mito_median = median(percent_mito, na.rm = TRUE),
    mito_mad = mad(percent_mito, center = median(percent_mito, na.rm = TRUE), constant = 1.4826, na.rm = TRUE),

    ribo_median = median(percent_ribo, na.rm = TRUE),
    ribo_mad = mad(percent_ribo, center = median(percent_ribo, na.rm = TRUE), constant = 1.4826, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_counts_lower = pmax(0, counts_median - ddqc_threshold * counts_mad),
    n_counts_upper = counts_median + ddqc_threshold * counts_mad,

    n_genes_lower_raw = genes_median - ddqc_threshold * genes_mad,
    n_genes_upper = genes_median + ddqc_threshold * genes_mad,

    percent_mito_upper_raw = mito_median + ddqc_threshold * mito_mad,
    percent_ribo_upper = ribo_median + ddqc_threshold * ribo_mad,

    n_genes_lower = pmin(n_genes_lower_raw, n_genes_lower_bound),

    percent_mito_upper = pmax(percent_mito_upper_raw, percent_mito_upper_bound)
  ) %>%
  select(
    cluster, n_cells,
    n_counts_lower, n_counts_upper,
    n_genes_lower, n_genes_upper,
    percent_mito_upper, percent_ribo_upper
  )

print(ddqc_cutoffs)

write.csv(
  ddqc_cutoffs,
  file = file.path(out_dir, "ddqc_cluster_cutoffs.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Adding labels to the cells
meta_ddqc_labeled <- meta_ddqc %>%
  left_join(ddqc_cutoffs, by = "cluster") %>%
  mutate(
    keep_ddqc =
      n_counts >= n_counts_lower &
      n_counts <= n_counts_upper &
      n_genes >= n_genes_lower &
      n_genes <= n_genes_upper &
      percent_mito <= percent_mito_upper &
      percent_ribo <= percent_ribo_upper
  )

cells_keep_ddqc <- meta_ddqc_labeled %>%
  filter(keep_ddqc) %>%
  pull(cell)

cat("Cells kept after ddqc:", length(cells_keep_ddqc), "\n")
cat("Cells removed by ddqc:", ncol(seu_prefilt) - length(cells_keep_ddqc), "\n")
cat("Fraction removed:", round((ncol(seu_prefilt) - length(cells_keep_ddqc)) / ncol(seu_prefilt), 4), "\n")

# Adding summary for cluster removal 
cluster_removal_summary <- meta_ddqc_labeled %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n_before = n(),
    n_after = sum(keep_ddqc),
    n_removed = sum(!keep_ddqc),
    frac_removed = n_removed / n_before,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ddqc_cutoffs_full <- ddqc_cutoffs %>%
  left_join(cluster_removal_summary, by = "cluster")

write.csv(
  ddqc_cutoffs_full,
  file = file.path(out_dir, "ddqc_cluster_cutoffs_with_removal.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Creating the ddqc-filtered object
seu_ddqc <- subset(seu_prefilt, cells = cells_keep_ddqc)

cat("Final ddqc object has", ncol(seu_ddqc), "cells\n")

# Reprocessing the filtered object
seu_ddqc2 <- seu_ddqc

seu_ddqc2 <- NormalizeData(seu_ddqc2, verbose = FALSE)
seu_ddqc2 <- FindVariableFeatures(seu_ddqc2, verbose = FALSE)
seu_ddqc2 <- ScaleData(seu_ddqc2, verbose = FALSE)
seu_ddqc2 <- RunPCA(seu_ddqc2, npcs = npcs_use, verbose = FALSE)
seu_ddqc2 <- FindNeighbors(
  seu_ddqc2,
  dims = 1:npcs_use,
  k.param = k_param,
  verbose = FALSE
)
seu_ddqc2 <- FindClusters(
  seu_ddqc2,
  resolution = cluster_resolution,
  algorithm = 1,
  random.seed = random_seed,
  verbose = FALSE
)
seu_ddqc2 <- RunUMAP(seu_ddqc2, dims = 1:npcs_use, verbose = FALSE)

markers_ddqc <- FindAllMarkers(
  seu_ddqc2,
  only.pos = TRUE,
  min.pct = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25,
  verbose = FALSE
)

top_cluster_genes <- markers_ddqc %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = as.character(cluster),
    cluster_label = make.unique(gene)
  ) %>%
  select(cluster, cluster_label)

print(top_cluster_genes)

seu_ddqc2$cluster_label <- top_cluster_genes$cluster_label[
  match(as.character(seu_ddqc2$seurat_clusters), top_cluster_genes$cluster)
]

cluster_label_order <- top_cluster_genes %>%
  mutate(cluster_num = as.numeric(cluster)) %>%
  arrange(cluster_num) %>%
  pull(cluster_label)

seu_ddqc2$cluster_label <- factor(seu_ddqc2$cluster_label, levels = cluster_label_order)

#saveRDS(seu_prefilt, file = file.path(out_dir, "seu_prefilt.rds"))
#saveRDS(seu_cluster, file = file.path(out_dir, "seu_cluster_pre_ddqc.rds"))
#saveRDS(seu_ddqc, file = file.path(out_dir, "seu_ddqc_filtered.rds"))
#saveRDS(seu_ddqc2, file = file.path(out_dir, "seu_ddqc_final_processed.rds"))

# Visualizations
# UMAP
p_umap_ddqc <- DimPlot(
  seu_ddqc2,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "cluster_label",
  label = TRUE,
  repel = TRUE,
  label.size = 3.8,
  pt.size = 0.18,
  raster = TRUE
) +
  ggtitle("ddqc UMAP") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_umap_ddqc)

#ggsave(
  #filename = file.path(out_dir, "Figure2_ddqc_fraction_removed_per_cluster.png"),
  #plot = p_removed,
  #width = 10,
  #height = 6,
  #dpi = 400
#)

# QC boxplots
p_box_mt <- ggplot(meta_ddqc_labeled, aes(x = factor(cluster), y = percent_mito)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = percent_mito_upper_bound, color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Percent mitochondrial reads by cluster",
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "percent.mito"
  )

p_box_genes <- ggplot(meta_ddqc_labeled, aes(x = factor(cluster), y = n_genes)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = n_genes_lower_bound, color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of genes by cluster",
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "n_genes"
  )

p_eda_box <- p_box_mt / p_box_genes

#ggsave(
  #filename = file.path(out_dir, "Figure3_ddqc_cluster_boxplots.png"),
  #plot = p_eda_box,
  #width = 12,
  #height = 10,
  #dpi = 400
#)

# Feature plots
p_feat_mt <- FeaturePlot(
  seu_cluster,
  features = "percent.mt",
  reduction = "umap",
  pt.size = 0.25,
  order = TRUE,
  raster = TRUE,
  min.cutoff = "q05",
  max.cutoff = "q95"
) + ggtitle("Pre-ddqc UMAP: percent.mt") + theme_bw(base_size = 14)

p_feat_genes <- FeaturePlot(
  seu_cluster,
  features = "nFeature_RNA",
  reduction = "umap",
  pt.size = 0.25,
  order = TRUE,
  raster = TRUE,
  min.cutoff = "q05",
  max.cutoff = "q95"
) + ggtitle("Pre-ddqc UMAP: nFeature_RNA") + theme_bw(base_size = 14)

p_feat_counts <- FeaturePlot(
  seu_cluster,
  features = "nCount_RNA",
  reduction = "umap",
  pt.size = 0.25,
  order = TRUE,
  raster = TRUE,
  min.cutoff = "q05",
  max.cutoff = "q95"
) + ggtitle("Pre-ddqc UMAP: nCount_RNA") + theme_bw(base_size = 14)

if ("percent.ribo" %in% colnames(seu_cluster@meta.data)) {
  p_feat_ribo <- FeaturePlot(
    seu_cluster,
    features = "percent.ribo",
    reduction = "umap",
    pt.size = 0.25,
    order = TRUE,
    raster = TRUE,
    min.cutoff = "q05",
    max.cutoff = "q95"
  ) + ggtitle("Pre-ddqc UMAP: percent.ribo") + theme_bw(base_size = 14)

  p_feature_grid <- (p_feat_mt + p_feat_ribo) / (p_feat_genes + p_feat_counts)
} else {
  p_feature_grid <- (p_feat_mt + p_feat_genes) / p_feat_counts
}

#ggsave(
  #filename = file.path(out_dir, "Figure4_pre_ddqc_featureplots.png"),
  #plot = p_feature_grid,
  #width = 14,
  #height = 12,
  #dpi = 400
#)

# Summary table
qc_summary <- data.frame(
  Step = c("Input object", "Basic filter", "DDQC"),
  Cells = c(ncol(seurat_obj), ncol(seu_prefilt), ncol(seu_ddqc))
)

qc_summary$Removed_from_previous <- c(
  0,
  ncol(seurat_obj) - ncol(seu_prefilt),
  ncol(seu_prefilt) - ncol(seu_ddqc)
)

qc_summary$Fraction_removed_from_previous <- c(
  0,
  (ncol(seurat_obj) - ncol(seu_prefilt)) / ncol(seurat_obj),
  (ncol(seu_prefilt) - ncol(seu_ddqc)) / ncol(seu_prefilt)
)

print(qc_summary)

#write.csv(
  #qc_summary,
  #file = file.path(out_dir, "ddqc_cell_count_summary.csv"),
  #row.names = FALSE
#)
```
